name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
languages: English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese*, Korean*languages with full audio support
short: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.
about: Early Purchase Bonus: Adventure Starter Set  A convenient item set that’s useful during the early stages of your adventure.  Included Items [Contents] - 10x Monster Munchies - 3x Bonus Balls - 5x Seeds of Skill  This bonus is included only for customers who purchase the main game or the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION by January 5th 2027 at 8.59am PST. This content can be claimed from “Check Additional Content” in the in‑game menu.   Digital Version Purchase Bonus: Hearty Meat Set  A set of meat items used when scouting monsters.  Included Items [Contents] - 5x Monster Munchies - 5x Smoked Sirloins - 5x Meaty Treats  Notes This bonus is included only for customers who purchase the digital version of the main game or the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION. This content can be claimed from “Check Additional Content” in the in‑game menu.   DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION  This bundle includes the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World and four packs of additional content, plus a selection of items to help raise stronger monsters. [Bundle Contents]  - DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World main game   - DLC 4-ITEM SET, which includes:  　- The Mega Mole Hole 　- Monster Marathons 　- Metallic Ring 　- Scout Run VIP Card - "Way of the Wrangler" DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION Purchase Bonus, which includes: 　- 1x Necklace of Animation 　- 10x Beastie Bites 　- 10x Seeds of Skill  - 48 hours of early access   *The content included in this bundle is also sold separately. Please be careful to avoid making duplicate purchases. *Early Access is planned to start on December 1st 2026 at 9.00am PST.   DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World DEMO  The free playable demo of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World allows you to experience the game from the start of the story up to the conclusion of events in Witherwood as you get to grips with recruiting, raising, and synthesizing monsters. For playing the demo, you can receive an item set for use in the full game. And, if you keep your save data from the demo, you'll be able to transfer the monsters in your main party and reserves into the full game.  *Only monsters of rank G and rank F can be befriended in the demo. *Bonus content cannot be claimed in the demo. Bonuses for Playing the Demo  - Wrangler's Bundle  　・Ring of Impulse x1 　・Bonus Ball x1 　・Smoked Sirloin x5  - Transfer up to 8 monsters from your main party and reserves to the full game   *Certain aspects of the game may differ between the demo and full versions. *Monsters in your main party and reserves can only be transferred from the demo to the full game if you have played both versions on the same gaming platform. *To access the bonuses in the full game that you receive for playing the demo, you must be using the same account on the same console or PC that you used to create your save data in DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World DEMO. *To claim your bonuses for playing the demo, please select "Start New Game" from the title screen in the full game. *Monsters transferred from the demo will be available from the depot in the full game, but they will begin at level 1 with their default talents. *You can add transferred monsters to your party once you have unlocked the depot in the full game. *Any items or gold etc. that you acquire in the demo cannot be transferred to the full game.   About the Game In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.  Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.  [About the Game] Befriend a Medley of Monsters - There's a whole host of monsters to befriend, including many familiar favorites from across the DRAGON QUEST series. - While each monster has its own traits and attributes, they can also learn a variety of talents, allowing you to fine tune your party to match your playstyle. - Combine two mons
